svg.title: Failures
svg.text: When links fail: guard, local repair, exception entry

g.text: guard: forward only to a neighbour strictly closer to D
the only closer one is behind the failed link: stop here, never loop
local repair: reach the same next hop around one grid square
needs only the link state within two hops
a whole satellite is down: no square detour reaches it
the walk toward D stops at the pink satellite
exception entry: one line, only where the walk broke
along the shortest working path; every flow to D shares it
